Bettina, I couldn't set up the recurring digest. The scheduler that runs Monday jobs isn't reachable from here: it returns a "gateway requires credentials" error, so I have not created anything, and nothing will post next Monday.

Once scheduling works, I'll post the digest here at 08:00 Chicago time, starting Monday 19 October. It will cover both #coastal-team and #coastal-random, which you and I can both see. It will leave out money terms like rates, prices, discounts and contract values, since this channel is shared with more than the finance people. Operational items like ticket numbers, seat counts, and renewal dates can stay in.

To fix the scheduling, someone with gateway access will need to restore its credentials. Ping me here once that's done and I'll set up the job and run one test digest.
